witnessReview.description: Attributable interpretation, separate from sourced qualifications; requires explicit inputs.

__schema1.description: ID inside the supplied document; not a URL.

__schema3.description: SHA-256 of exact supplied document bytes.

artifact.description: One exact artifact in the scoped observation inventory. A URL, title or legacy hash cannot substitute for this identity.

__schema44.description: An attributed authenticity or source-credibility review, not an automatic result of snapshot validation.

__schema50.description: Method used to verify media authenticity.

__schema54.description: Trust tier of a source — an orthogonal axis to confidence and temporal certainty.

__schema61.description: An attributed material or analytical review, never an automatic quality, origin or scientific-validity finding.

__schema62.description: Collection/handling quality of a physical evidence item.

__schema63.description: Custody status of an evidence item.

__schema74.description: Reviewer-selected factor labels; no built-in weighting or validation of their truth.

__schema76.description: Retained vocabulary for attributable reviews. Anonymity never adds a penalty automatically.
